data_source: Koios REST API https://api.koios.rest/api/v1 (blocks, block_tx_cbor, tx_info)
methodology: Enumerated mainnet blocks via GET /blocks?block_height=gte.X&lte.Y (500/page, ascending).
Fetched raw tx CBOR via POST /block_tx_cbor in batches of <=20 block hashes.
Decoded each tx with python3 cbor2: tx = [body, witness_set, ...]; witness_set map key 2 = bootstrap witness array (CBOR tag 258 set unwrapped where present).
For every tx with >=1 bootstrap witness, resolved regular input addresses via POST /tx_info {_inputs:true} and read inputs[].payment_addr.bech32.
Classified input addresses: 'addr1...' = Shelley; base58 'DdzFF...'/'Ae2...' = Byron.

Class (a) = >=1 bootstrap witness. Class (b) = class (a) with zero Byron inputs (all-Shelley inputs) -- the legacy-Daedalus dual-witnessing pattern the pre-#754 code rejected with bootstrap:address_binding_failed.
Rate limited to <=2 requests/second; anonymous Koios tier.
Stop condition: >= 5 class-(a) AND >= 1 class-(b), or 250000 blocks scanned, or height 9400000 reached.

bootstrap_witness.note: chain_code is all zeros and attributes are an empty map; pubkey AND signature are byte-identical to the vkey witness (dual-witnessing: the same Ed25519 key was emitted both as a Shelley vkey witness and as a Byron bootstrap witness).

class_b_verification.cred_check: blake2b224(witness pubkey) == 3d1230c3c4c233575d978d7877b447d76a7c30e1d1ef66662a41691e == payment credential of both (Shelley enterprise, addr1vy73yvxrcnprx46aj7xhsaa5gltk5lpsu8g77enx9fqkj8s8rf28d) inputs, so the vkey witness covers the inputs and the bootstrap witness binds to NO Byron input.
class_b_verification.relevance_to_754: This on-chain mainnet tx (accepted by cardano-node, epoch 430) carries a bootstrap witness while spending only Shelley-era inputs. Pre-fix dugite required every bootstrap witness to bind to a Byron input address and rejected such txs with bootstrap:address_binding_failed (false positive). Fix e5cc177174 instead checks that all Byron INPUTS are covered by some bootstrap witness, which is vacuously satisfied here, matching Haskell semantics.
